_about: Settings for the KB PR check. The rules themselves are read from Foundation 0 in this repository; this file only tunes how the check applies them.
_caps_about: Fallback only. Foundation 0 Section B4 sets the length caps; from v2.3 it states them in words, and the check reads them from there and blocks on them. These numbers apply, as suggestions only, when a branch carries a Foundation 0 that states its caps in pages.
_severity_about: Turns a rule to blocking, advisory or off. Empty means every rule follows Foundation 0, except A3-owner-role, which advises until set here (PLAN D1). Set "A3-owner-role": "blocking" once every function doc names its Function Lead as Owner.
_readable_about: The readable check comes from the emma-readable skill. Its rules are not in Foundation 0 yet, so it advises and does not block. Set readable_severity to blocking once they are.
_readable_skip_about: sentence is skipped because Foundation 0 Section B1 sets a stricter cap (28 words) and kb-check.py reports it.
_allow_caps_about: Acronyms and method terms written in capitals by their source (MUST and WANT are Kepner-Tregoe's terms). An ALL-CAPS word for emphasis is not on this list and stays a finding.
_unnumbered_about: Headings Section B2 does not number: Purpose (part 3), References (allowed after the body from Foundation 0 v2.3) and Changelog (the last part).
